personalHint: Ideas use each child's age and what you wrote on their family card (notes and allergies).
addKidTitle: No child in the family yet
addKidDescription: Add the children to get ideas suited to their ages.
degradedDisabled: offline ideas — no AI model configured
conflictDescription: Another activity already occupies that time for this child.
scheduleFailedTitle: The activity could not be planned

treasure-hunt-garden.title: Garden treasure hunt
treasure-hunt-garden.instructions: Hide five objects, draw a map and start the search.

obstacle-course.title: Backyard obstacle course
obstacle-course.instructions: Build a course in the garden and time every run.

herbarium.title: Neighbourhood herbarium
herbarium.instructions: Collect leaves, dry them and glue them in with their names.

picnic.title: Picnic the children make
picnic.instructions: They plan the menu, make everything and pick the picnic spot.

paper-boats.title: Paper-boat race
paper-boats.instructions: Fold the boats, fill a basin and blow them across.

watering-weeding.title: Water and weed the vegetable patch
watering-weeding.instructions: Everyone takes a row. Water in the evening to avoid evaporation.

land-art.title: Land art with what you find outside
land-art.instructions: Make a picture on the ground from natural bits, then photograph it.

neighbourhood-olympics.title: Neighbourhood Olympics
neighbourhood-olympics.instructions: Invite the neighbours, invent five events and keep a scoreboard.

blanket-fort.title: Sheet-and-branch den
blanket-fort.instructions: Build a den, then have the snack in it.

cookies.title: Baking workshop: cookies
cookies.instructions: They weigh, mix and shape. You only open the oven.

board-game.title: Make your own board game
board-game.instructions: Invent the board, the rules and the pieces, then play it together.

shadow-theatre.title: Shadow theatre
shadow-theatre.instructions: Cut out characters, hang a sheet and perform the story for the parents.

construction-challenge.title: 30-minute building challenge
construction-challenge.instructions: The tallest tower that stands for ten seconds. Stopwatch running.

story-writing.title: Write and illustrate a story
story-writing.instructions: One chapter each, one drawing per page, then read it aloud.

timed-tidy-up.title: Timed tidy-up with music
timed-tidy-up.instructions: One song, one room. Anything lying around goes back before it ends.

kitchen-science.title: Kitchen science experiments
kitchen-science.instructions: Volcano, invisible ink, liquid density. Write down what you see.

yoga-balance.title: Yoga and balance course
yoga-balance.instructions: A line on the floor, poses held for ten seconds, harder each round.

grandparents-interview.title: Call and interview the grandparents
grandparents-interview.instructions: Five questions about their childhood, and write the answers down.

postcards.title: Postcards for friends
postcards.instructions: Everyone draws a card, writes a note and addresses it. Then to the postbox.

toy-sort.title: Sort toys to give away
toy-sort.instructions: Three piles: keep, give, repair. They choose, you don't arbitrate.
